zh.title: 银行客户流失：模式、解释与服务容量
zh.description: 结合 10,000 名客户的分组分析、模型比较与 SHAP 解释，识别流失信号并设计服务优先级。冻结阈值 0.275 的测试召回率为 78.39%、精确率为 48.25%，进一步比较不同服务容量下的覆盖与成本。

en.title: Bank churn: patterns, explanations and service capacity
en.description: Group analysis, model comparison and SHAP across 10,000 customers identify churn signals and inform service priorities. At the frozen threshold of 0.275, test recall is 78.39% and precision is 48.25%; capacity and cost comparisons guide follow-up planning.

zh.title: 电商首单欺诈：时间评估与审核建议
zh.description: 围绕 138,376 笔首单交易，分析购买时序、设备与 IP 行为，比较不平衡处理方法。通过前向验证和成本情景评估，提出按模型分数与交易线索分级的人工审核方案。
stats: 冻结决策检出 / 欺诈标签

en.title: First-order fraud: temporal evaluation and review proposals
en.description: Analyze purchase timing, device and IP behavior across 138,376 first-order transactions, and compare class-imbalance methods. Forward validation and cost scenarios inform a tiered manual-review proposal using model scores and transaction signals.

zh.title: LendingClub：9,004 笔贷款样本
zh.description: 从 9,004 笔历史贷款中分析违约分布，比较模型与期限规则，设计不对称成本下的筛查策略。Random Forest 冻结阈值 0.22，测试召回率 70.45%，净模拟成本降幅 4.68%。

en.title: LendingClub: the 9,004-loan sample
en.description: Analyze default patterns in 9,004 historical loans, compare models with a loan-term rule, and design screening policies under asymmetric costs. Random Forest at the frozen threshold of 0.22 achieves 70.45% test recall and a 4.68% net simulated cost reduction.

zh.title: YouTube 评论：养宠文本信号与频道筛选
zh.description: 对 5,818,979 条评论构建弱监督分类与频道候选排名，结合 TF-IDF、行为特征和 SHAP 分析养宠文本信号。300 条新评论经助手复核，294 条可判定，条件加权精确率为 0.8982。
stats: 新样本可判定 / 助手复核
助手复核条件加权精确率

en.title: YouTube comments: ownership signals and channel screening
en.description: Build weakly supervised classification and channel candidate rankings from 5,818,979 comments, using TF-IDF, behavioral features and SHAP to analyze pet-ownership language. Assistant review of 300 new comments yields 294 determinate labels and conditional weighted precision of 0.8982.
stats: Conditional weighted precision from assistant review

zh.title: A/B Testing：Cookie Cats 关卡门实验
zh.description: 比较 90,189 名玩家的留存与参与度，结合分流检验、自助法和统计功效评估关卡门位置。第 40 关组的 7 日留存比第 30 关组低 0.82 个百分点，95% 区间为 [−1.33, −0.31]，据此提出关卡与回访体验建议。
stats: 分流比例检验 p 值

en.title: A/B Testing: the Cookie Cats gate experiment
en.description: Compare retention and engagement across 90,189 players, combining allocation checks, bootstrap estimates and power analysis. Seven-day retention is 0.82 percentage points lower in the level-40 group than the level-30 group, with a 95% interval of [−1.33, −0.31], informing gate and return-experience recommendations.

zh.title: Healthy Home：奥克兰空间预测与道路地图
zh.description: 结合 18,219 个观测点、道路网络与嵌套空间评价，分析奥克兰污染物分布。随机森林在区域分块评价中的 NO₂ 合并 R² 为 0.576017，道路相对预测图覆盖 628.74 km，并通过分区误差诊断提出补充观测方案。
stats: 区域分块 RF NO₂ 合并 R²

en.title: Healthy Home: spatial prediction and road mapping in Oakland
en.description: Combine 18,219 observations, road networks and nested spatial evaluation to analyze pollutant patterns in Oakland. Random Forest achieves pooled NO₂ R² of 0.576017 under spatial-block evaluation. Relative prediction maps cover 628.74 km of roads, with area-level error analysis informing further sampling.

zh.title: Amazon 手表评论：聚类、主题与改进建议
zh.description: 从 960,872 条原始记录中整理评论语料，使用 K-Means 与 LDA 分析 858,037 条建模评论。故障／退货主题均分 2.37 星，覆盖建模一星评论的 52.9%，为产品排查、说明优化与评论监测提供线索。
stats: 故障/退货主题平均星级

en.title: Amazon watch reviews: clustering, topics and recommendations
en.description: Prepare the review corpus from 960,872 raw records and analyze 858,037 modeled reviews with K-Means and LDA. The malfunction/returns topic averages 2.37 stars and covers 52.9% of modeled one-star reviews, informing product checks, clearer instructions and review monitoring.

zh.title: LendingClub 全量分析：时间评估与容量取舍
zh.description: 对 800,634 笔到期终态贷款进行时间切分，比较模型排序、阈值与费用情景。在固定 10% 复核容量下，LightGBM 命中率为 37.88%，等级规则为 32.38%；结合 SHAP 解释与成本分析提出人工复核方案。

en.title: Full-data LendingClub: temporal evaluation and capacity trade-offs
en.description: Use temporal splits of 800,634 mature terminal loans to compare ranking, thresholds and cost scenarios. At a fixed 10% review capacity, LightGBM achieves a 37.88% hit rate versus 32.38% for the grade rule. SHAP and cost analysis inform a manual-review proposal.

zh.title: S&P Global Capstone：气候模型、预测与空间暴露
zh.description: 在 2022 年 Capstone 基础上完成 2026 年重建分析，覆盖四个研究框、1,020 个格子，串联气候模型比较、短期预测、长期情景与空间暴露。2035–2044 年 ssp585 情景下，204 个格子×暴露层条目满足拟议优先核查规则。
stats: 主模型集合；敏感性分析含 15 个
拟优先核查 / 基准格子×层条目

en.title: S&P Global Capstone: climate models, forecasts and spatial exposure
en.description: A 2026 reconstruction of the 2022 capstone covers four study boxes and 1,020 cells, connecting climate-model comparison, short-term forecasting, long-term scenarios and spatial exposure. Under ssp585 for 2035–2044, 204 cell–layer entries meet a proposed priority-check rule.

zh.title: Capstone 专题：模型比较
zh.description: 比较四个研究框中 MODIS LST 与 NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 tas 的历史表现，分析变量、日历和采样差异。以 15 个模型开展误差诊断，并在 14 个模型的主集合上评价排名不确定性，为后续模型选择与订正提供依据。

en.title: Capstone study: model comparison
en.description: Compare historical MODIS LST and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 tas across four study boxes, accounting for variables, calendars and sampling. Diagnose errors across 15 models and assess rank uncertainty in the 14-model main ensemble to inform model selection and bias correction.

zh.title: Capstone 专题：长序列与短期预测
zh.description: 基于 2000–2024 年共 299 个月的观测记录，使用五个测试窗口比较 12 与 24 个月预测。按区域选择月气候态基线，并识别 TK 的 Prophet 与 AU 24 个月 SARIMA 候选方法，结合趋势和校准诊断安排后续检验。

en.title: Capstone study: long records and short-term forecasts
en.description: Use 299 months of observations from 2000–2024 and five test windows to compare 12- and 24-month forecasts. Regional comparisons retain climatology baselines and identify TK Prophet and AU 24-month SARIMA as candidate methods, with trend and calibration diagnostics guiding further evaluation.

zh.title: 长期配对情景与空间暴露
zh.description: 以 14 个模型比较两种长期情景的配对温差与超阈月数，结合人口、建成区和耕地分布分析空间暴露。通过校准敏感性和成员影响分析，将情景差异转化为候选地点核查顺序。
stats: 近窗 ssp585：优先核查 / 基准条目

en.title: Paired long-term scenarios and spatial exposure
en.description: Compare paired temperature differences and exceedance months across two long-term scenarios using 14 models, then combine population, built surface and cropland to assess spatial exposure. Calibration sensitivity and member-influence analysis inform the order of candidate-site checks.
